# PR #6804 — round 2: two review findings remain (CHANGES_REQUESTED)

You authored PR #6804 (branch cursor/atlas-6711-wotd-hub-locale). The re-review left findings 2 and 4 NOT-RESOLVED — read the PR comment "Re-review (delta 9967c79e→04e78b39)" on https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/pull/6804 and apply BOTH on the same branch:

Finding 2 — the per-locale visibility test must exercise PRODUCTION CSS, not a copy pasted into the test. Read the actual stylesheet source that ships the .lu-i18n show/hide contract (wherever the layout defines it), inject that real CSS into the test DOM, then assert computed visibility per locale. Acceptance: temporarily deleting the production CSS rule makes the test FAIL (include this mutation check in your PR comment evidence).

Finding 4 — production's inline watchdog in DailyWords.astro is still untested; your behavioral tests cover armDailyWatchdog, which production never calls. IMPORTANT DESIGN CONSTRAINT: the inline duplication is intentional resilience — the is:inline script must keep working when the module chunk fails to load (#6771), so it must NOT import shared modules. Fix by testing the real thing: in the test, extract the is:inline script source from DailyWords.astro and evaluate it against a DOM fixture; assert the loading → watchdog-fallback transitions (and that a ready section is left alone). If armDailyWatchdog is now dead code no production path calls, delete it and its parallel implementation instead of keeping two watchdogs.

Rules: same dispatch worktree and branch; mutation-check every new/changed test (revert guarded behavior → test fails; quote it); cd site && npx tsc --noEmit && scoped npx vitest run; push to the same branch (no new PR); summarize fix-per-finding with quoted evidence in a PR comment; do NOT merge / no auto-merge.

**Finding 2** — Visibility test now extracts CourseLayout’s real `.lu-i18n` CSS, injects it, and asserts `getComputedStyle` per locale. Deleting the rules or flipping `display: none` → `inline` fails the test.

**Finding 4** — Tests extract and `eval` the production `is:inline` watchdog from `DailyWords.astro` (loading → fallback; ready left alone). Removed dead `armDailyWatchdog` / `isDailyWatchdogDue` — production never called them; the inline copy stays for CDN-fail resilience.
